description: pixel art landscape, the misty marshes of nawia, the slavic underworld: still black water between dead willows, pale blue ghost lights floating in thick fog, a rotten wooden footbridge leading to a dark gate woven of roots, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, very dark muted palette of ghostly teal, grey fog and deep violet, no text, no border, no people in front, no animals in front
